gen-gf-noto-serif-toto-archivo: Bookish and quietly authoritative, Noto Serif Toto sets its soft thick-thin strokes against Archivo. And that body face is the sturdier voice, its outward-opening curves and commanding x-height giving the pair real backbone.
gen-gf-noto-serif-toto-montserrat: Noto Serif Toto's restrained thick-thin strokes and full bowls give it a bookish gravity. Montserrat then glides along beneath in wire-like lines with generous white space, so a long read feels light and easy to follow.
gen-gf-nova-mono-fs-ranade: Nova Mono draws every curve as thick as its stems, a precise, technical machine of a heading above Ranade's slightly rubbery strokes. Rigid meets organic.
gen-gf-nova-mono-work-sans: Typewriter precision, then a modern turn. Work Sans carries the longer reading with high mean lines and c tips held well apart, so text stays open and unhurried.
gen-gf-nova-round-fs-rowan: Fat ribbons of constant width, loud and rounded. Nova Round is made to shout, while Rowan, with its friendly openings and gentle thick-thin shift, is the one to settle into, though not for endless paragraphs.
gen-gf-offside-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Be Vietnam Pro takes the quiet role here. Offside spreads wide, expressive and unclosed above it, so give the body text enough size to hold its own against that commanding display.
gen-gf-offside-fs-fira-sans: Wide, open and a bit defiant. Fira Sans brings uniform strokes and a tall x-height under Offside's unclosed curves, and that steadiness against such showy letters is the pair's best trick.
gen-gf-offside-fs-hind: Offside spreads its widely tracked, unclosed curves across the top with expressive confidence. But Hind answers in lowercase that nearly matches its capitals, and that tidy, level texture is what holds the pair together.
gen-gf-offside-fs-karma: Curves that refuse to close give Offside its ruler-and-compass look, expressive and widely tracked. And Karma settles beneath it with a small pinch where curves meet stems, a trustworthy text voice with a tight x-height to cap height.
gen-gf-offside-fs-merriweather-sans: Offside stretches out in widely tracked, unclosed curves, with crossbars as heavy as its stems, while Merriweather Sans sits beneath. Its sturdy tall lowercase is the real strength.
